entries.german: verspricht Ulrich v. Rosenberg, ihn für alle in seinen Diensten erlittenen Verluste schadlos zu halten. Ad m. d. r. Michael prepos. Boleslav.
entries.english: He promises Ulrich von Rosenberg to compensate him for all losses he has suffered in his service. By mandate of the Roman king; Michael, provost of Boleslav.
